title: Code component <-> Figma node map
description: The running record of which code components have a Figma representation, and where. A component ABSENT from this map has no Figma representation yet — that absence is the signal, which is why entries are added when the work is done and never in advance.

components.description: Keyed by the code component name in PascalCase.

icons.description: Optional. Icons are usually one component set with many variants rather than one entry each.

codePath.description: Repo-relative path to the component directory, e.g. packages/react/src/components/Button.

pageId.description: EPHEMERAL. Source-file local; refreshable, never a durable join.

componentKey.description: Publish-time stable key — the DURABLE join. Null until the source file is published as a library. Never rewrite a non-null key from a scan; a changed key means a different component, not a moved one.

assetType.description: `not-modelled` is the sentinel for a component deliberately not built in Figma. Put the reason in `note` — an empty entry reads as unfinished work.

axes.description: Figma variant property -> its values, TitleCase property with prop-exact values. Must agree with the component's extracted prop value sets; a disagreement means the two surfaces describe different components.

dependsOn.description: DIRECT dependencies only — components instanced inside this one. Not transitive.
